stories.title: Araghchi calls for accountability over US use of Japan's airbase to attack Iran
stories.summary: Araghchi calls for accountability over US use of Japan's airbase to attack Iran Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi has called on the Japanese public to hold their government accountable over reports that US military assets stationed in Japan were used in operations against Iran. Speaking to Kyodo News, Araqchi referred to reports that US Air Force F-16 fighter jets deployed from Misawa Air Base to the Middle East took part in operations against Iran. “The peace-loving people of Japan should ask their government to be held accountable for the crimes committed by the United States,” Araqchi said, arguing that Tokyo bears responsibility for how military facilities and capabilities based in

stories.title: Greece, Turkey clash over protected Aegean marine areas
stories.summary: Turkey has announced the creation of two protected zones in a disputed area of the Aegean Sea, sparking an angry reaction from Greece. Does this mark a new chapter in a long-running dispute between the two countries?

stories.title: Harry Potter: Versailles turns into wizarding school for a day
stories.summary: Accio nostalgia! ⚡️ Can you believe it’s been 25 years since Harry Potter first hit the big screen? To celebrate, French fans turned the Palace of Versailles into Hogwarts for a unique reunion. 📹 France 24 was there to capture the magic.
